root: Original migration inspector and all unchanged original migration API routes under token prefix.
workspace: workspace/ serves new forms_report.py rendered HTML; use ../ for full migration inspector.
forms_summary: api/forms/summary -> complete bounded result summary; class summary includes content_state counts and scope_state, separate from comparison status; each class includes examined_asset_count,unexamined_asset_count,unexamined_assets_route. Unexamined original findings kind=asset_coverage carry asset_id/asset_side for navigation.
forms_attachments: api/forms/attachments?side&availability&search&offset&limit -> paged complete explicit attachments, with actual body status and verified parent record
downloads: download/forms/project.zip (when supplied exact complete verified archive)
paging: default40,max500; full downloads never take page limits. All source data/filter values escaped/lossless. Same original private token/Host/Origin controls.
asset_fields: All original plan asset fields plus asset_id=id, retained_path, actual_bytes,actual_sha256,table_ids; unavailable has null retained/actual.; content_state is distinct from body availability, defaults UNASSESSED. No total migration acceptance is inferred from whole retained bytes.
attachment_fields: All original explicit fields plus body {availability,bytes,sha256,asset_id} and parent_status MATCHED|MISSING_RECORD|KEY_MISMATCH|INVALID_LINK; missing/ref mismatch retained as findings.; parent_status also includes SIDE_MISMATCH or CLASS_MISMATCH. Parent asset_class defaults responses; a different class requires explicit reference.
forms_intake_receiving: api/forms/intake-receiving -> complete intake with PRESENT asset paths rewritten to retained originals, runnable with input-root=received project
